Our Teachers | Arrow Yoga top of page arrow yoga logo ABOUT Meet the Owner Contact STUDIO Schedule Pricing Class Descriptions Our Teachers FAQS Private Yoga Membership Assistance Account Login TRAININGS 200 Hour | Fall 2026 200 Hour | Winter 2027 Terms Attendance Policy YTT Portals RETREATS Italy Residency Norway France Booking Terms Insurance Inclusivity ON DEMAND Class Rentals Memberships Members Login BOOK A CLASS OUR TEACHERS At Arrow Yoga, our teachers are devoted practitioners who live and embody the principles of yoga both on and off the mat. With deep knowledge of safe, intelligent movement, they skillfully guide students through classes that build strength, mobility, and awareness while honoring individual needs. But beyond the physical, our teachers infuse spirituality and intention into every practice—blending breathwork, philosophy, and mindful sequencing to create an experience that nourishes both body and soul. Each class is more than just movement; it is a contemplative journey, inviting you to turn inward, and align with your highest self. IMG_6432.JPG Owner/Founder/Teacher Dani Reidy With a decade of experience in a variety of yoga lineages + modalities, Dani's classes weave the multi-faceted tools of yoga, including philosophy, inquiry, breath work into an intentionally curated vinyasa sequence. Known for her creative and rigorous classes that intricately weave the subtle sciences into the class theme, her philosophy is to lovingly encourage you to expand your capacity to feel, to experience, and to grow. ​ Betsyheadshot.JPG Manager/Lead Teacher Betsy Cogswell Betsy is a Baltimore-based yoga teacher trained in vinyasa through Arrow Yoga. With a background in engineering and a certification in integrative nutrition, she blends her analytical thinking, passion for whole-body wellness, and spiritual curiosity when crafting her classes. She strives to create transitions that cultivate fluidity and presence, encourage self-study, and thoughtfully apply concepts from ancient yogic philosophy to everyday life. LizWattPhotography-62_edited.jpg Teacher Tess Manning Tess fell in love with yoga over a decade ago when she was introduced to her first class and discovered how powerful the practice is. Her classes are designed to feel accessible to all levels and honor yoga’s ancient roots. She uses thoughtfully paced sequences to help her students find strength and stillness in both their bodies and minds. Tess is a 200-hour Registered Yoga Teacher (RYT). She received her certification from Arrow Yoga in 2023. LizWattPhotography-118_edited.jpg Teacher Madeline Langfitt Madeline completed her 200 Hour YTT with Arrow Yoga in May 2026. A devoted student with over a decade of practice, her teachings reflect her generous heart, her awareness of the body, and her appreciation for this practice. Come to experience a grounded and light hearted approach to your practice, and leave with greater awareness of your full self. ​ ​ 2B1C26BC-583C-460E-9FFA-7E140E005CDD_edi Teacher Maya Basik Maya Basik completed her 200-hr yoga teacher training in 2012 through Charm City Yoga, supplemented by her 300-hr training in Bali in 2020. Her extensive background as a dancer and dance educator influences her personal practice as well her classes through a focus on fluid and graceful transitions, anatomy, and creative expression. She enjoys weaving seasonal and earth-based wisdom into her classes, and is passionate about supporting her students in cultivating a sense of freedom, safety, and aliveness in the body. IMG_8721_edited.jpg Teacher Hannah Paulding My teaching style blends strength, flow, and breath to help students feel grounded and energized. My practice is shaped by classical yoga lineages while honoring the wisdom of functional anatomy and subtle energetics. I personally value the powerful tools yoga offers for emotional regulation, resilience and holistic wellbeing. In my classes, we’ll create a welcoming space to sweat, release, and grow both on and off the mat. ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ Screenshot 2025-02-03 at 12.44_edited.jpg Teacher Margot Antonelli Margot is a devoted lifelong student of yoga. She completed her first 200-hour training in 2022 and her second with Arrow Yoga in 2024. Her teaching weaves together mindful movement, radical self-acceptance, and the transformative power of presence. With a grounded belief that each person is their own best guide, she offers space for students to reconnect with their inner wisdom and move with intention. Her classes are an invitation to come home to yourself—just as you are. ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ ​ IMG_3151_edited.jpg Teacher Allison Dayton With a background in dance, Allison brings a fluid, expressive quality to her yoga classes. Her teaching style blends creative sequencing with mindful movement, offering students the freedom to explore and express themselves. Rooted in both self-inquiry and embodied awareness, her classes encourage personal discovery while cultivating strength, grace, and presence. Expect a supportive space where you’re invited to move intuitively, breathe deeply, and connect more fully with your practice 5I5A3482-2.jpg Teacher Mona Bhatt Yoga has been part of my life for as long as I can remember, inspired by my Indian heritage and the daily practice of my grandparents. Over the past 10+ years, I’ve explored Vinyasa and Restorative styles, finding joy in how each brings its own balance of strength and stillness. I completed my 200-hour teacher training with Dani at Arrow Yoga, where I deepened my understanding of purposeful sequencing and intentional movement. My classes are designed to help students cultivate their inner power, connect with their breath, and move with mindful flow. I aim for every student to leave feeling both grounded and energized, carrying the benefits of practice into their everyday life! ​ ​ OUR TEACHERS POST_edited.jpg Teacher Jane Berg Jane has been practicing yoga for over a decade and sharing her love of Power Vinyasa Yoga as a teacher for the past two years. She is passionate about helping her students build strength through mindful movement, and emphasizes safe alignment so students feel supported in their practice. She weaves yogic philosophy into her teaching, offering students insights that connect the physical practice with mindfulness and self-discovery. Her supportive and encouraging teaching style creates an empowering space for students to explore, grow, and connect with their practice. Jane hopes her students leave feeling grounded, inspired and more connected with themselves. She completed her 200 hour YTT with Dani through Arrow Yoga in 2023. R0000552_edited.jpg Teacher Lindsay Boone Lindsay graduated from a 200 hour Baptiste inspired teacher training in 2022. Her classes are both strong and playful, with a focus on mindful awareness. Through intentional coordination of breath and movement, she aims to create opportunities for students to truly drop into the moment. ​ ​ ​ ​ tereza 5_edited.jpg Teacher Tereza Dvorak Tereza is a Baltimore-based yoga teacher and psychotherapist. For the past decade, she has been exploring the intersection of movement and mental health. She teaches with the belief that tending to ourselves is inseparable from tending to one another; by cultivating presence and balance within through yoga, we can expand our capacity to connect, support, and contribute to more compassionate and joyful communities. arrow yoga logo 2 ARROW YOGA ​ A boutique yoga studio in Baltimore offering daily heated vinyasa classes, trainings, international retreats & more. ​ ​ > Thanks for subscribing! ABOUT | Arrow Yoga top of page arrow yoga logo ABOUT Meet the Owner Contact STUDIO Schedule Pricing Class Descriptions Our Teachers FAQS Private Yoga Membership Assistance Account Login TRAININGS 200 Hour | Fall 2026 200 Hour | Winter 2027 Terms Attendance Policy YTT Portals RETREATS Italy Residency Norway France Booking Terms Insurance Inclusivity ON DEMAND Class Rentals Memberships Members Login BOOK A CLASS At Arrow Yoga, we see yoga as a work in as much as a workout. We believe in the power of movement — in strengthening the body, releasing stored energy, and feeling fully alive. But we also know that the real shifts often happen beneath the surface. Through breath, stillness, and presence, yoga becomes a practice of returning to yourself. ​ It's not either/or — it’s both. A way to move through what’s stuck, and become more available to all that is. HOT VINYASA ° TRAININGS ° RETREATS ° Arrow Yoga hosts thoughtful and powerful yoga classes, workshops, trainings, retreats, mentorship programs and explorations of many kinds. Rooted in the ancient and translated to meet the present, our teachings encompass the many facets of yoga, incorporating the mind, body and heart to provide practical tools and spiritual solutions to help you navigate your inner and outer world. ​ Our offerings employ a diverse range of techniques that incorporate creative and intentional vinyasa sequences, informed by functional anatomy, subtle energetics, pranayama, philosophy, inquiry, and meditative practices. We blend techniques from a variety of lineages to curate unique experiences that foster embodied spirituality. Each one of our offerings is grounded in learning how to cultivate presence and to see everything as an opportunity to practice choice. ​ ​ ​ IMG_0674.JPG Our healing is both personal and collective. We recognize the power of being in this practice together; it is through community that we remember the sacred. We belong to the whole, and need one another. We love to host experiences that that bring humans together, and are inspired to create a community that is grounded in love, truth, and connection. ​ We also want to acknowledge that yoga is an ancient science, philosophy, and art, codified and originated in India. ​ The materials we resource are used and shared with sincerity and reverence to the many generations and lineages of teachers who have provided their wisdom. We continue their legacy by working to recognize the names & places where this information was born, continuously learning with deep curiosity and respect for words and experiences of those that came before us, and continue to provide for all of our benefit, and by making this practice accessible to all. It is because of them, that we have these maps to cultivate a liberated life. To them, we bow. Arrow Yoga | Meet our founder top of page arrow yoga logo ABOUT Meet the Owner Contact STUDIO Schedule Pricing Class Descriptions Our Teachers FAQS Private Yoga Membership Assistance Account Login TRAININGS 200 Hour | Fall 2026 200 Hour | Winter 2027 Terms Attendance Policy YTT Portals RETREATS Italy Residency Norway France Booking Terms Insurance Inclusivity ON DEMAND Class Rentals Memberships Members Login BOOK A CLASS MEET DANI ​ Dani Reidy is a mother, teacher, and the founder of Arrow Yoga. She lives in Hampden, Baltimore, and is deeply rooted in the community she serves. ​ A 500-hour E-RYT, Dani has taught thousands of hours of yoga around the world since 2013. She began her practice through Baptiste Yoga, drawn to the intensity of asana, but quickly fell in love with the deeper dimensions of the practice—its philosophy, energetics, and power to reprogram the subconscious mind. Her work bridges ancient wisdom with modern tools to help students live more liberated, intentional lives. ​ With a background in dance, Dani brings a refined understanding of movement—blending biomechanics with the expressive rhythm of breath and body. Her classes are intelligently sequenced and energetically attuned, offering vinyasa, restorative, or yin practices that invite inquiry, depth, and transformation. ​ Dani is a lifelong student. She continues to study under Ally Bogard and has trained with renowned teachers including Baron Baptiste, Elena Brower, Rod Stryker, Janet Stone, Abbie Galvin, Anodea Judith, and many more. She is also a certified Mindfulness Meditation Teacher under Tara Brach and Jack Kornfield, with a deep commitment to Buddhist-inspired practices of awareness and compassion. Her certifications span Tantra, meditation, yoga nidra, prenatal yoga, and chakra psychology. ​ Arrow Yoga was created from Dani’s desire to be of service—to support others through compassionate awareness, meaningful connection, and the transformative tools of yoga. Accredited through Yoga Alliance in 2020, Arrow offers trainings, workshops, and immersive experiences designed to help students explore, embody, and evolve. ​ Since 2015, Dani has led over 30 international retreats across 17+ countries—from Iceland to Indonesia—offering students the opportunity to travel with purpose. With a background in Anthropology, she weaves movement, rest, reflection, and culture into every journey. ​ At home in Baltimore, Dani lives with her husband, their two sons, James and Rowan, and their rescue cats, Bo and Mick. She considers motherhood her most profound and humbling practice of all. "My yoga practice led me to the discovery that I have every opportunity to align with the version of myself that I always desired. I learned that my practice was not a matter of doing; striving to be someone different; but was of remembering the me that already was, and is, whole and complete. I searched a lifetime looking for answers to all of my questions, wondering why life was happening to me, feeling stuck in fear, lost in uncertainty and doubt. It wasn't until I learned to expand my perspective, ask different questions, and truly listen, that my life and my suffering transformed. Yoga offered me an outlet to develop trust in myself, resiliency in moments of challenge, and ultimately to train my attention to stay in presence, so that I could learn to live less out of habit and more out of conscious choice. I understand this work, this heart work, is the work of my life time yet, I am grateful that I now have tools and a technique that I can reference to create support and trust in all that is unknown. This practice offers us a map to self understanding and is the compass to guide us forwards. I am so honored that we've found each other to share in this practice, together." Love, Dani 5I5A0053.jpg It is a shared commitment to service that creates something truly powerful. Our team is the heart of Arrow.
